problem: Audit a claim against its source in a citation court: AI prosecution and defence raise parameters from the source; a deterministic gateway verifies quotations word by word and returns a supported / refuted / unsupported verdict, evidence cards, and refusal records. No web retrieval, no general chat.

sample.note: Samples are fixed in-repo case sets and replay receipts; external data collection is out of scope.
